image_description: A row of five disposable plastic lighters arranged diagonally against a white background. The lighters are translucent in red, teal/green, and blue colors. They feature standard metal wind guards and ignition mechanisms at the top. Some lighters have white text printed on their bodies.

The refraction and internal texture of the plastic look slightly uniform and 'waxy' rather than having the crisp optical distortions expected from real molded plastic and liquid fuel.
